==Description==
The '''Pumpkin Crate''' is an exclusive crate that was only obtainable during the [[Halloween 2020 Event]] from the [[Halloween 2020 Event#Halloween Season Pass|Halloween Season]] at Rank 1, 2, 5 and 6. Each Rank would grant you one '''Pumpkin Crate''', except Rank 6, which gave you two.

This crate provides special Halloween-themed skins, more specifically pumpkin and jack-o-lantern themed. Some of the skins could have been earned previously with the [[Halloween 2019 Crate]].

The appearance of the '''Pumpkin Crate''' is similar to the [[Spooky Crate]]. It is a large brown and light brown chest with a pumpkin emblem on the front. Green leaves also decorate the chest. It is opened by a crowbar.

==Trivia==
*Despite the {{Color|Unobtainable|Pumpkin}} [[Militant]] skin being listed as an obtainable skin through the '''Pumpkin Crate''', the skin is not obtainable through this crate.
*The {{Color|Pumpkin|Pumpkin}} placement sound is the same as [[Lord Sinister]]'s "''Heh.''" voiceline.
*If you redeemed the [[Codes|code]] ''1pumpkin'' or ''30k'', you would get one '''Pumpkin Crate'''.
*If you have the {{Color|Halloween2019|Pumpkin}} skins from the [[Halloween 2019 Crate]] ([[Cowboy]], [[Minigunner]]/[[Golden Minigunner]] and [[Rocketeer]]), you cannot re-open the same skins in this crate.
**Therefore, if you have all the [[Halloween 2019 Crate]] skins, then you can only open two '''Pumpkin Crate''' as you cannot get duplicates of event skins.
**You cannot get any other [[Halloween 2019 Crate]] skins with the '''Pumpkin Crate'''.
